title: Core: AS2 prototype chain and inheritance depth
description: Verify deep prototype chains compile and run correctly: class A {}, class B extends A {}, class C extends B {}, class D extends C {}. Verify that D instances have method resolution through the full chain. Also test prototype property assignment at runtime: MyClass.prototype.newMethod = function(){}. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/protodepth.test.ts.
